foodOn.label: black pepper (whole or pieces)

citation.source: FoodOn (foodon.org), an OBO Foundry ontology, CC BY 4.0. Matched via EBI Ontology Lookup Service (OLS4) search API against the live FoodOn ontology, verified 2026-08-19.

foodOn.note: Entity-level match against this repo's default/whole state. black_pepper.json also models cracked/ground states -- FoodOn has separate classes for those (e.g. FOODON:03306739 "black pepper (ground)") but this crosswalk maps one class per ENTITY, not per state, same scope as nutrition-extension.ts's own entity-level (not state-level) mapping.
